_doc: DEFAULT sponsor task-automation rules shipped with the public template. Edit for your event. The sponsor task DEFINITIONS (titles, audiences, completion) live in code (CommunityHub.Core/Tasks/Definitions/SponsorTaskDefinitions.cs); their body text lives in config/tasks/<edition>/sponsor/*.md. This file carries what stays per-edition: deadline rules, webshop product classification, contact roles, the swag catalogue, the event-platform sponsor categories and the per-tier booth specs. Community-specific text is written as {{placeholder}} markers resolved from event.<edition>.json -> placeholders. With integrations.woocommerce disabled, sponsor orders come from manual CSV import, but these rules still drive task generation.

deadlineRules._doc: Named deadline rules referenced by the sponsor task definitions. basis 'eventMinus' = event start date minus N days; 'eventEndPlus' = the event's last day plus N days; 'contractPlus' = the sponsor's first-order date plus N days, with fallbackNowPlus used when no order date is known.

downloadLeads._doc: A POST-event task: the day after the event's last day.

orderImport._doc: Column mapping for a webshop order export (manual CSV import; mirrors what the WooCommerce pull produces). Sponsor identity keys on email.

sponsorContacts._doc: A sponsor is a COMPANY with several contacts and roles. With a company directory integration enabled, companies/contacts/roles come from it and this list maps its role ids to labels; without it, the hub manages contacts itself using these roles. reminderTargeting decides who receives sponsor task reminders.

roles.label: Event Coordinator
roles._doc: Receives all sponsor reminders. Can assign tasks.

roles.label: Signer / Approver
roles._doc: Never receives task reminders. Record/contact only.

roles.label: Booth Staff
roles._doc: Hub-only role. Reminded only for a task assigned to them.

reminderTargeting._doc: ASSIGNED task: the assignee is primary and all coordinators are copied. UNASSIGNED task: all coordinators are primary. Signers never receive reminders.

productClassification._doc: How each ordered webshop product is classified — by its category text and/or its name, never by a static product-id list, so next edition's products need no config change. A product can match several types; each matched type's tasks are added. Matching is substring and case-insensitive. The category names below are an example webshop structure; rename them to match yours.

rules._doc: Booth packages: any product whose category contains an exhibitor-package-with-booth category, OR whose name contains a booth code like 'Booth E-12'.
rules._tierDoc: The booth tier is read from the per-tier categories ('Platinum Exhibitor', 'Diamond Exhibitor', 'Gold Exhibitor', 'Feature Exhibitor'). No tier category -> defaultTier.

rules._doc: Sponsor session products — one category per session length.
Branded feature sponsorships without their own booth, and digital-only tiers. They still get the baseline sponsor tasks (logo, descriptions, app game).
Pre-day master-class track sponsors. These may ALSO match 'booth' — both task sets apply.
Logistics add-ons — not sponsorships (furniture, package handling, extra staff tickets, TV screen). Recognised so they are not reported as unmatched, but they generate no tasks.

swagCatalog._doc: The sponsor swag catalogue IS the webshop: every product in the category named here is shown with its own price, picture and short description. Matching is substring and case-insensitive. bagQuantity is how many pieces one bag order is. currencySymbol is shown beside prices (empty = bare numbers).

zohoSponsorCategoryMap._doc: Optional (Zoho Backstage only). Webshop product CATEGORY -> event-platform sponsor CATEGORY. A company buying in several categories gets one sponsor record per heading. Needles are substring, case-insensitive, against the same category text productClassification uses. Every heading used here needs an id in event.<edition>.json -> zohoSponsorCategoryIds.

boothWallSpecs._doc: Per booth tier: wall size, the wall-design spec file, the webshop coupon for the furniture included in the package, the number of booth members included, and the furniture guidance. Substituted into booth tasks as {{wallSpecUrl}}, {{couponCode}} and {{furnitureSpec}} for the company's classified tier ({{furnitureSpec}} is substituted first, so a {{couponCode}} inside it resolves too).
